messages:
maria_sales: Hi team — customer (Finova) just signed off on features, asking for final POC teardown timeline. They specifically want: Hosted API keys invalidated, dedicated pool drained + released, and VPC/private deployment creds rotated. Can we confirm steps and ETA?

aditya_se: I can own the key revocation and pool drain. Proposed plan: 1) schedule drain of dedicated pool 2) revoke hosted API keys 3) rotate VPC service account keys + rotate KMS wrapping key if used 4) confirm data retention/snapshots + legal hold. ETA: ~4 hours once we start.

maria_sales: Thanks. Is there a safe order so customer traffic doesn't 500? They'll keep a small test job running until we signal done.

aditya_se: Order: 1) Put customer application into read-only/test mode (they're doing this) 2) drain dedicated pool with --grace to let in-flight requests finish 3) revoke hosted keys (this prevents new traffic from using hosted API) 4) rotate VPC creds + KMS. If they keep a test job that polls, draining with a 30m grace should avoid mid-request failures.

kate_sre: Addendum from SRE side: run pool drain command and monitor tokens-in-flight. Quick commands:```bash
# drain pool (example)
redwoodctl pool drain --pool-id pool-finova-poctest --grace-period 1800
# revoke hosted key
redwoodctl keys revoke --key-id rwd-hosted-finova-01
# rotate VPC service account
redwoodctl vpc rotate-credentials --vpc-id vpc-xyz --service-account finova-poc
```
We'll tail metrics in the console and stop draining early only if we see >95% requests complete.

jules_support: For data retention: Finova requested deletion of PII-derived logs older than 30d, and they asked for a final exports archive. We need to: 1) snapshot logs/metrics (if requested) 2) confirm retention TTLs (S3 lifecycle) 3) run deletion jobs for DB traces / kv-cache per their contract. Legal wanted copies of the retention confirmation.

legal_bot: @jules_support please attach the signed DPA clause id 3.2 about retention. If they have legal hold, we cannot delete until release.

jules_support: They confirmed no legal hold. I'll request the final export and then run deletions. ETA for export: ~1 hour.

aditya_se: Coordination note — revoke vs rotate: revoking hosted API keys is immediate and safe after drain. Rotating VPC creds will require updating any customer-managed tunnels; we need their ops contact. Who's the contact?

maria_sales: Contact is "ops@finova-cloud.com" (Paul Nguyen). I can loop him in.

kate_sre: Also: mark the dedicated pool as "pending-release" in infra to avoid autoscale reattaching. Command: `redwoodctl pool set-meta --pool-id pool-finova-poctest --meta pending_release=true`

aditya_se: I'll run the pool drain and set-meta. Plan timeline: start 10:00 PDT, drain 30m, revoke hosted keys 10:35, request VPC cred rotation window 10:40, start data export 10:45. Total ~2 hours.

maria_sales: Sounds good. Please post progress updates here. I'll notify the customer.

ops-bot: Scheduled job created: job_id=jb-8942, action=pool-drain, start_ts=1951237200, pool=pool-finova-poctest, grace=1800s.

aditya_se: pool drain started (job=jb-8942). Monitoring: 12 active connections -> 3 -> draining.

kate_sre: Observed 98% request completion after 12m. Safe to proceed with key revoke in 3m.

aditya_se: revoking hosted keys now. `redwoodctl keys revoke --key-id rwd-hosted-finova-01` -> response: OK (revoked). :white_check_mark:

jules_support: export job completed (s3://finova-exports/poc-2026-09-01.tar.gz). Starting deletion of PII logs older than 30d per DPA.

aditya_se: VPC creds rotation request sent to Paul's ops. Waiting for confirmation to proceed with service-account rotation.

maria_sales: Paul confirmed. He asked if we can do a midnight window in his timezone — suggested 23:00 their local (02:00 PDT). He wants brief downtime ok.

kate_sre: That's fine. For midnight window we'll schedule rotation + KMS wrap rotate. We'll produce a rollback plan: re-enable old creds for 15m if anything fails.

jules_support: Deletions complete. I uploaded the retention attest to the contract folder and pinged legal for sign-off.

aditya_se: All steps complete: pool released to infra queue, hosted key revoked, export + deletions done, VPC rotation scheduled. Closing POC assets checklist and sending handoff email to Finova.

maria_sales: Thanks everyone. Please confirm the final checklist items in the COLO ticket and tag me. :tada:
